newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi man beheaded for killing compatriot.
newsitem.headline: Saudi man beheaded for killing compatriot.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Thursday beheaded a Saudi man for stabbing a compatriot to death after a fight, Saudi state-run television said.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by the television said the man was beheaded in the city of Khamis Mushait in southwestern Saudi Arabia.
The beheading was the first execution in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year.
Saudi Arabia, which executed 68 people in 1996, enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
